title: Range Breaker
briefing: Lumen Bikes has spent weeks in a tight range near $50. Momentum Max and Breakout Bea are both waiting for it to break out. Only one breakout on this chart is real.
objective: Read the chart: buy the confirmed breakout, skip the rumour spike, and exit when the trend breaks.
debrief: Lumen Bikes broke out of its range on day 2 when orders doubled, closing strongly on heavy volume, then climbed in a clean uptrend of higher highs and higher lows. On day 20 an unconfirmed takeover rumour pushed it to a new high, and Breakout Bea bought it. The denial on day 21 gapped it down, and the chart turned to lower highs and lower lows. Buying the confirmed breakout with a trailing stop, and skipping the rumour spike, beat both opponents.

news.headline: Lumen Bikes orders double as city e-bike schemes expand
news.body: Three large cities have ordered Lumen e-bikes for their rental schemes, doubling the company's order book.

news.headline: Lumen Bikes: "We are not in takeover talks"
news.body: Lumen Bikes says the report is wrong and no one has approached the company.
